BloodiedTriumphs.Title: Bloodied Triumphs
BloodiedTriumphs.Description: Critical moments achieved by a hero who is already badly hurt.

SurroundedStillStanding.Title: Surrounded, Still Standing
SurroundedStillStanding.Description: Critical moments achieved while several enemies immediately threaten the hero in melee.

GiantSlayerMoments.Title: Giant-Slayer Moments
GiantSlayerMoments.Description: Critical moments against opponents far beyond the hero in power and level.

NarrowEscapes.Title: Narrow Escapes
NarrowEscapes.Description: Critical moments achieved when several dangerous circumstances converge.

EnableBloodiedTriumphs.Name: Enable Bloodied Triumphs
EnableBloodiedTriumphs.Hint: Registers Bloodied Triumphs as an active Critical Forge theme pack.

EnableSurroundedStillStanding.Name: Enable Surrounded, Still Standing
EnableSurroundedStillStanding.Hint: Registers the theme pack for heroes immediately threatened by several enemies.

EnableGiantSlayerMoments.Name: Enable Giant-Slayer Moments
EnableGiantSlayerMoments.Hint: Registers the theme pack for critical success against substantially higher-level opponents.

EnableNarrowEscapes.Name: Enable Narrow Escapes
EnableNarrowEscapes.Hint: Registers the theme pack for critical moments under an especially dangerous combination of circumstances.

BloodiedThreshold.Name: Bloodied Triumphs threshold
BloodiedThreshold.Hint: Maximum current hit point ratio at which an actor counts as bloodied. Default: 0.5 or 50%.

SurroundedThreshold.Name: Required threatening enemies
SurroundedThreshold.Hint: Minimum number of automatically evaluated melee threats for Surrounded, Still Standing.

GiantSlayerThreshold.Name: Giant-Slayer level gap
GiantSlayerThreshold.Hint: Minimum difference between the opponent's level and the rolling actor's level.

NarrowEscapeThreshold.Name: Narrow Escape danger score
NarrowEscapeThreshold.Hint: Minimum score of the additive danger model. The current formula is documented by the module.

Notifications.Refreshed: Against All Odds packs were refreshed.
Notifications.RegistrationFailed: PF2E Critical Forge: Against All Odds could not register with Critical Forge. See the console for details.

NotYet.Title: Not Yet
NotYet.Description: Pain turns into force before it can become weakness. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Strike damage.

PainHonedEdge.Title: Pain-Honed Edge
PainHonedEdge.Description: Every wound redraws the line of your next attack. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

BackAgainstTheWorld.Title: Against the Whole World
BackAgainstTheWorld.Description: Your counterstroke tears open the defense that should have ended you. The target is off-guard for 1 round.

BloodInTheStride.Title: Blood in the Grip
BloodInTheStride.Description: The pain steadies your hands and gives your threat a terrible certainty. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics and Intimidation checks.

YouFlinchFirst.Title: You Flinch First
YouFlinchFirst.Description: The target recoils before the wounded creature that should have broken. The target becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round.

CrimsonAfterimage.Title: Crimson Afterimage
CrimsonAfterimage.Description: The spell leaves a second, blood-red impact inside every wound it opens. For 1 round, you gain a +2 status bonus to spell damage.

WillThroughTheWound.Title: Will Through the Wound
WillThroughTheWound.Description: The successful spell proves that your will is still stronger than your injuries. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

WoundHoldsTheWeave.Title: The Wound Holds the Weave
WoundHoldsTheWeave.Description: For one impossible moment, your injuries anchor magic instead of weakening it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to all damage.

ScarletOpening.Title: Scarlet Opening
ScarletOpening.Description: The critical spell leaves the target's defenses traced in red. For 1 round, the target takes a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws.

OneMoreBreath.Title: One More Breath
OneMoreBreath.Description: The spell buys a heartbeat from a future that had already spent it. You may immediately Step as a free action, following the normal restrictions of Step.

BloodAnswersBlood.Title: Blood Answers Blood
BloodAnswersBlood.Description: Your own wounds make the strike cruelly exact. The target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

BreachForEveryone.Title: A Breach for Everyone
BreachForEveryone.Description: Your critical blow opens a seam that every weapon can find. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 2 to weapons.

StealTheirBeat.Title: Steal Their Beat
StealTheirBeat.Description: The hit lands exactly when the enemy needs their rhythm most. The target becomes slowed 1 for 1 round.

StrengthRunsRed.Title: Strength Runs Red
StrengthRunsRed.Description: The wound steals leverage from every motion that follows. The target becomes enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

HuntTheOpening.Title: Hunt the Opening
HuntTheOpening.Description: The critical blow creates a path and your wounded body takes it before caution can object. You may immediately Step as a free action, but you must end the Step closer to the target if possible.

Spellscar.Title: Spellscar
Spellscar.Description: The magic does not merely strike; it leaves a place where more magic wants to enter. For 1 round, the target gains weakness 2 to damage from spells.

PainHoldsTheFormula.Title: Pain Holds the Formula
PainHoldsTheFormula.Description: Your injuries strip away every unnecessary thought until only the spell remains. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your spell DC.

ThoughtBleedsBack.Title: Thought Bleeds Back
ThoughtBleedsBack.Description: The mental impact rebounds through the opening it created. The target becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round.

PowerRefusesToFade.Title: Power Refuses to Fade
PowerRefusesToFade.Description: The spell should be over. The pain in your body refuses to let it end. The target takes 1d4 persistent force damage.

MagicNailsTheShadow.Title: Magic Nails the Shadow
MagicNailsTheShadow.Description: The spell pins the target's motion to the instant of impact. For 1 round, the target takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds.

HeartRefuses.Title: The Heart Refuses
HeartRefuses.Description: The body hears the order to fail and answers with another beat. For 1 round, you gain 6 temporary Hit Points.

BitterBlood.Title: Bitter Blood
BitterBlood.Description: Your wounded body turns hostile to every toxin that enters it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to poison damage.

BodyAsBastion.Title: Body as Bastion
BodyAsBastion.Description: Muscle, bone, and stubbornness lock into one defensive shape. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and Fortitude DC.

FleshBecomesArmor.Title: Flesh Becomes Armor
FleshBecomesArmor.Description: Pain hardens the body faster than steel can break it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 2 to physical damage.

SecondPulse.Title: Second Pulse
SecondPulse.Description: A second rhythm rises beneath the first and drags you back from the brink. For 1 round, you gain fast healing 4.

NoRoomForNausea.Title: No Room for Nausea
NoRoomForNausea.Description: Your body has more urgent work than surrendering to sickness. For 1 round, you are immune to the sickened condition.

BloodObeys.Title: Blood Obeys
BloodObeys.Description: The blood already spilled is enough; the rest stays where you command it. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to bleed damage.

NervesRefuse.Title: The Nerves Refuse
NervesRefuse.Description: Shock races through you and finds every nerve already occupied by defiance. For 1 round, you are immune to the stunned condition.

StrengthDoesNotLeave.Title: Strength Does Not Leave
StrengthDoesNotLeave.Description: Your strength may bend, but for one more moment it cannot be taken from you. For 1 round, you are immune to the enfeebled condition.

CloseTheWound.Title: Close the Wound
CloseTheWound.Description: Your body seizes one injury and forces it toward an ending. You may immediately attempt the recovery check for one persistent damage effect affecting you, using DC 10 instead of its normal DC.

BetweenTheBlades.Title: Between the Blades
BetweenTheBlades.Description: There is no safe path, so you make one between the edges. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and Reflex DC.

BloodRedBlur.Title: Blood-Red Blur
BloodRedBlur.Description: For one heartbeat, your wounded outline becomes impossible to follow. For 1 round, you are concealed.

RunBeforeFalling.Title: Run Before Falling
RunBeforeFalling.Description: Your body spends tomorrow's strength on surviving now. For 1 round, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your land Speed.

TurnTheBlastAside.Title: Turn the Blast Aside
TurnTheBlastAside.Description: You do not escape the force completely; you teach it to pass around what remains of you. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to area damage.

NoAngleLeft.Title: No Angle Left
NoAngleLeft.Description: Every line of attack closes a fraction too late. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

NeverWhereNeeded.Title: Never Where They Expect You
NeverWhereNeeded.Description: The enemy's perfect opening keeps finding empty air. For 1 round, you are immune to the off-guard condition.

FeetRefuseGround.Title: The Feet Refuse the Ground
FeetRefuseGround.Description: Even the floor cannot decide where to catch you. For 1 round, you are immune to the prone condition.

WoundTaughtBalance.Title: Wound-Taught Balance
WoundTaughtBalance.Description: Pain has become a map of every dangerous shift in your weight. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

SlipTheSnare.Title: Slip the Snare
SlipTheSnare.Description: Nothing gets to hold you while survival still has somewhere else to be. For 1 round, you are immune to the immobilized condition.

TwoHeartbeatsAhead.Title: Two Heartbeats Ahead
TwoHeartbeatsAhead.Description: You are already leaving the place where death expected to find you. You may immediately Step twice as a free action. Each Step must move you farther from the hostile source, and the normal restrictions of Step apply.

MindRefuses.Title: The Mind Refuses
MindRefuses.Description: Your thoughts close ranks around the one command that still matters: endure. For 1 round, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves and Will DC.

NothingLeftToFear.Title: Nothing Left to Fear
NothingLeftToFear.Description: Fear searches your wounds for purchase and finds every place already occupied by resolve. For 1 round, you are immune to the frightened condition.

NoMasterHere.Title: No Master Here
NoMasterHere.Description: The invading will reaches for a throne and finds only shattered stone and a blade waiting beneath it. For 1 round, you are immune to the controlled condition.

PainIsProof.Title: Pain Is Proof
PainIsProof.Description: The wound is real, the blood is real, and the lie has nowhere left to hide. For 1 round, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and Will saves.

HeartRemembers.Title: The Heart Remembers
HeartRemembers.Description: Someone else may command your feelings, but they cannot rewrite why you are still standing. The hostile source becomes stupefied 1 for 1 round.

ThoughtBehindTheBlood.Title: Thought Behind the Blood
ThoughtBehindTheBlood.Description: Behind the pain, one untouched thought remains and shelters everything that follows. For 1 round, you gain resistance 3 to mental damage.

ClearAsTheWound.Title: Clear as the Wound
ClearAsTheWound.Description: Agony burns every false direction away until only the next necessary choice remains. For 1 round, you are immune to the confused condition.

EyesBehindTheEyes.Title: Eyes Behind the Eyes
EyesBehindTheEyes.Description: The assault opens a colder awareness behind your ordinary senses. For 1 round, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks and Perception DC.

DefianceLooksBack.Title: Defiance Looks Back
DefianceLooksBack.Description: The intruder meets your gaze from inside your own mind and realizes it has entered the wrong place. The hostile source becomes frightened 1 for 1 round.

CutTheHook.Title: Cut the Hook
CutTheHook.Description: The failed intrusion leaves its barb exposed. You may immediately reduce your frightened or stupefied condition by 1. Choose one condition if both apply.
